claims.statement: 1954 선거 자유당 의석수는 114로 모든 동시대 외교기록과 일치한다
insufficient_evidence: 미국 5/23 원전문1231 및 중앙선관위 1954 확정 당선공고 미확보
claims.detail: FRUS English footnote Liberal115, DNP15, independent67, minor6=203; NIKH later Liberal114, DNP15, independent68, minor6 implied. Party affiliation/official nomination date may explain, but unproven.

claims.statement: FRUS 1954-05-24 한국어 번역의 소수정당 7석은 영어 원문의 6석과 일치한다
contradicting_evidence: Same FRUS English note minor parties6 vs Korean translated note minor parties7; 115+15+67+6=203, +7=204
claims.conclusion: Prefer original English for what FRUS note states, do not silently alter archived translation. Actual Korean NEC category pending.

claims.statement: 1954-05-24 미국 대사의 자유당 공식 공천 후보자와 총 친여 후보자는 동의어다
claims.conclusion: Telegram explicitly contrasts 'official' Liberal candidates with non-official Liberals and pro-government independents; avoid equating 115 total with officially endorsed count. Original endorsed candidate list still open.

claims.statement: 1954년 선거의 경찰 개입은 1954-07-14 미대사관 동시대 보고에서 주장·관찰됐다
insufficient_evidence: American officers' five attached observation memoranda not printed; British two also not printed; UNCURK A/2711 not opened
claims.conclusion: Contemporaneous diplomatic observer assessment supports documented allegation of police interference, not a proven individual presidential direct order. Distinguish officer observations, embassy inference, police unit orders.

claims.statement: 1954-07-14 FRUS 문서에 부속된 미국 참관 메모 5개와 영국 메모 2개가 모두 FRUS에 인쇄돼 있다
claims.conclusion: Footnotes explicitly say enclosures not printed; separate archival retrieval targets 795B.00/7-1454 and 795B.00/6-454.

claims.statement: 1954년 자유당 114석 당선과 6월16일 136석 교섭단체 등록은 같은 날짜의 동일 지표다
contradicting_evidence: Later essay says 114 at election, 127 June9, 136 June16
claims.conclusion: Different dates and affiliation definitions. Exact membership transfers and official June16 register require original.
